reason: The metadata-only capacity census showed thousands of species can satisfy the largest raw-photo target. Querying every such species in the fresh candidate stage would recreate an all-at-once mega-analysis and could create an unnecessarily large URL-bearing candidate artifact. This amendment fixes a bounded species envelope before fresh candidate acquisition and before any flower-colour pixels are opened.

candidate_species_budget.selection_rule: If the frozen capacity result contains at most 1000 selected species, query them all. Otherwise rank all capacity-selected inat_taxon_id values by SHA256(seed + unit-separator + inat_taxon_id), with taxon ID as deterministic tie-break, and fresh-query the first 1000 taxa.

relationship_to_measurement_budget.purpose: retain a fixed two-fold pre-pixel reserve against fresh metadata acquisition attrition without outcome-dependent replacement
